subject.title: Fix stale session routes for removed providers

question: Should OpenClaw treat persisted session provider/model routes that are absent from current config/catalog as invalid at runtime and fall back to the configured default?
rationale: The code path looks correct for the reported bug, but the behavior intentionally changes existing persisted session routing and can move traffic across provider/auth boundaries after upgrade.

options.title: Accept fallback-to-default semantics
options.body: Merge the runtime guard and treat stale absent provider routes as invalid while leaving persistent cleanup as follow-up work.

options.title: Require stricter stale-route handling
options.body: Ask for fail-closed or diagnostic behavior when catalog loading fails instead of preserving unknown merge-mode routes.

options.title: Expand the scope before merge
options.body: Require doctor/reset cleanup or persisted-state migration in this PR before accepting the runtime behavior change.

recommendation.title: Accept fallback-to-default semantics
recommendation.body: Merge the runtime guard and treat stale absent provider routes as invalid while leaving persistent cleanup as follow-up work.

likelyOwner.reason: Current history and co-authorship tie this owner candidate to the resolver behavior and provider/session routing surface.
